title: Support shift+enter in most terminals
body:
You can capture shift+enter using the [kitty protocol](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/keyboard-protocol), which is supported by kitty, ghostty, alacritty, wezterm, iterm2, and some more terminals I haven't heard of.

This will also be better for iterm2 users, as it won't break their shift+enter for other TUIs.
author: net
